description: A multi-layer network-based agent-based model for the diffusion of mask-wearing behavior through social influence, information diffusion, and policy intervention. Calibrated on panel micro-data (days 0-29) with out-of-sample prediction for days 30-39.

behaviors.name: decide_mask_wearing
behaviors.description: Daily decision to wear a mask based on logistic probability with persistence, social influence by layer, information received, and policy enforcement.
behaviors.algorithm: Compute logit score from weighted sum of predictors; convert via sigmoid to probability; sample Bernoulli; apply dropout with small probability; enforce supply constraint (must have mask_inventory >= min_inventory_to_wear).

behaviors.name: update_risk_perception
behaviors.description: Risk perception updates from media and peer information signals (bounded in [0,1]).

behaviors.name: interact_with_peers
behaviors.description: Compute exposure fractions per layer (family, work/school, community).
behaviors.algorithm: For each layer, compute fraction of neighbors wearing masks at t-1; weight by w_layer and mobility_rate to produce effective exposure.

behaviors.name: consume_media
behaviors.description: Receive exogenous information with daily hazard as a function of media and government guidance.
behaviors.algorithm: p_media = 1 - exp(-lambda_media_daily * communication_intensity); received_info_t = received_info_{t-1} OR Bernoulli(p_media).

behaviors.name: respond_to_policy
behaviors.description: Adjust adoption probability by mandate_strength and perceived enforcement after Day 10.
behaviors.algorithm: policy_boost = mandate_active ? mandate_strength * enforcement_probability * exp(-compliance_decay_rate * (t - policy_start_day)) : 0; add policy_boost to log-odds.

behaviors.name: purchase_masks
behaviors.description: Acquire masks subject to stock, price, and affordability; inventory supports wearing.
behaviors.algorithm: purchase_prob = mask_availability * sigmoid(-price_elasticity * (budget/price - 1)); if Bernoulli(purchase_prob) and stock>0: decrement stock and increment mask_inventory.

interactions.name: social_peer_influence
interactions.description: Agents observe peers’ mask-wearing in their social network and update attitudes and adoption based on thresholds and influence weights.
interactions.effect: Updates effective exposure per layer; shifts adoption probability via logistic term for peer fractions.

interactions.name: policy_compliance_enforcement
interactions.description: Government imposes mask requirement from Day 10; agents adjust behavior with mandate_strength and perceived enforcement.
interactions.effect: Adds policy_boost to adoption log-odds; may override adoption if not enough supply or if noncompliance drawn.

interactions.name: information_diffusion
interactions.description: Information propagates via social ties and media; increases received_info state and boosts adoption.
interactions.effect: Updates received_info via hazard from peer exposures and exogenous media.

interactions.name: supply_and_purchase
interactions.description: Agents purchase masks from retailers subject to stock and price; inventory enables wearing.

interactions.name: intra_household_influence
interactions.description: Household members influence each other to adopt and share masks.
interactions.effect: Household exposure adds to family layer influence; shared inventory can enable wearing for low-inventory members.

modules.name: NetworkManager
modules.description: Loads and cleans the multiplex social network; constructs per-layer neighbor lists and degrees.

notes: Edges are made undirected if symmetrize_edges=true.
Neighbor lists are stored for fast exposure calculation.

modules.name: ExposureCalculator
modules.description: Computes per-agent, per-layer peer mask fractions and info contact counts each day.

notes: Layer weights w_L scale the intensity of exposure.
mobility_rate scales contacts active per day.
Computes exposure based on t-1 states to avoid simultaneity.

modules.calibration_notes: w_family, w_work_school, w_community and mobility_rate shape adoption slope and peak.

modules.name: PolicyAndMedia
modules.description: Activates mandate from Day 10 and broadcasts guidance; generates policy and media signals.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if day >= policy_start_day:
  mandate_active = 1
  enforcement_level = enforcement_probability
  guidance_intensity = communication_intensity * mandate_strength
else:
  mandate_active = 0
  enforcement_level = 0
  guidance_intensity = communication_intensity * 0.5
emit signals
notes: guidance_intensity feeds InformationDiffusion and risk perception updates.
enforcement_level interacts with adoption log-odds as policy_boost via MaskAdoptionDecision.

modules.calibration_notes: mandate_strength and enforcement_probability control mid-trajectory acceleration.

modules.name: InformationDiffusion
modules.description: Updates each agent’s received_info via peer hazards and exogenous media.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each agent i:
  if received_info[i] == 1: continue
  # Media hazard adjusted by guidance
  p_media = 1 - exp(-(lambda_media_daily * media_effect_weight * max(guidance_intensity, 1e-6)))
  # Peer hazard assuming independent contacts
  p_peer_family = 1 - (1 - p_info_contact_family) ** info_contacts[i].family
  p_peer_work = 1 - (1 - p_info_contact_work_school) ** info_contacts[i].work_school
  p_peer_comm = 1 - (1 - p_info_contact_community) ** info_contacts[i].community
  p_total = 1 - (1 - p_media) * (1 - p_peer_family) * (1 - p_peer_work) * (1 - p_peer_comm)
  received_info[i] = Bernoulli(p_total)
notes: Assumes monotone received_info (once true, stays true).
Hazard form prevents probabilities >1 and aggregates across channels.

modules.calibration_notes: Hazard parameters tuned to match observed info prevalence trajectory.

modules.name: MaskAdoptionDecision
modules.description: Decides mask wearing daily using logistic probability with persistence, social exposure by layer, received_info, and policy boost.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each agent i:
  prev = is_mask_wearing[i]
  # Dropout for previous adopters absent exposure
  if prev == 1 and Bernoulli(recovery_or_dropout_prob):
    is_mask_wearing[i] = 0
    continue
  # Group modifiers
  age_mod = {Youth: age_mod_youth, 'Young Adult': age_mod_young_adult, 'Middle Age': age_mod_middle_age, 'Older Adult': age_mod_older_adult}[age_group[i]]
  occ_mod = {Student: occ_mod_student, 'White Collar': occ_mod_white_collar, 'Blue Collar': occ_mod_blue_collar, Service: occ_mod_service}[occupation[i]]
  infl_mod = social_influence_weight * age_mod * occ_mod
  # Policy boost
  policy_boost = 0
  if policy.mandate_active:
    days_since_policy = max(0, day - policy_start_day)
    policy_boost = enforcement_level * exp(-compliance_decay_rate * days_since_policy)
  # Logit score
  z = alpha_intercept
  z += gamma_risk_perception * risk_perception[i]
  z += infl_mod * (beta_peer_family * peer_mask_fraction.family[i] + beta_peer_work_school * peer_mask_fraction.work_school[i] + beta_peer_community * peer_mask_fraction.community[i])
  z += delta_received_info * received_info[i]
  z += phi_persistence * prev
  z += policy_boost
  p = 1 / (1 + exp(-z))
  # Supply constraint
  if mask_inventory[i] < min_inventory_to_wear:
    is_mask_wearing[i] = 0 if Bernoulli(1 - p) else 0  # cannot wear without inventory
  else:
    is_mask_wearing[i] = Bernoulli(p)
notes: Inventory gates the ability to wear even with high propensity.

modules.calibration_notes: Micro-to-macro: fit coefficients via logistic hazard, then refine via simulation-based optimization.

modules.name: RetailMarket
modules.description: Maintains retailer stock and processes mask purchases by agents.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if day == 0:
  stock_level = retailer_initial_stock_per_capita * population_size
  price = mask_cost_mean
for each agent i:
  affordability = budget[i] / price
  purchase_prob = mask_availability * sigmoid(-price_elasticity * (affordability - 1))
  if stock_level > 0 and Bernoulli(purchase_prob):
    mask_inventory[i] += 1
    stock_level -= 1
# Restock and adjust price
restock_qty = retailer_restock_rate * population_size
stock_level += restock_qty
price = max(0.1, mask_cost_mean * (1 + 0.1 * (1 - stock_level/(population_size + 1e-6))))
notes: Simple price adjustment based on stock pressure.
Purchase probability increases with affordability and availability.

modules.calibration_notes: Kept parsimonious; not primary calibration target.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily adoption and info rates; computes group-specific rates.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate_daily[day] = mean(is_mask_wearing[:]) + Normal(0, observation_noise_std)
adoption_rate_by_age_daily[day, g] = mean(is_mask_wearing[age_group==g])
info_rate_daily[day] = mean(received_info[:])
notes: Observation noise optional; set to small value to reflect measurement noise.
Group rates used for inequality metrics.

algorithms.DiscreteTimeLogisticAdoption: Logistic probability with persistence, social exposure per layer, info boost, and policy boost; Bernoulli sampling with inventory constraint.
algorithms.PeerExposureComputation: Neighbor state aggregation per layer with weights and mobility scaling.
algorithms.InfoHazardAggregation: Independent channel hazards combined via 1 - product(1 - p_k).
algorithms.CMAESCalibration: Simulation-based optimization over parameters minimizing weighted loss of RMSE/MAE and secondary targets.
algorithms.GiniAcrossGroups: Gini coefficient across group-level adoption rates at a specified day.
